full_page.content:
Page 41 Cont.
July 28 Babe Walter Berger - 3 months - in St. Mary's Hosp. fell out of bed last Sunday, has not kept anything on stomach since and bleeding.
Thanks - Grandfather of baby just described had very threatening rupture last January. His folks came and enrolled him and asked for prayers .... working now every day.
Mrs. Debusschere - 65 ....
29 Alice Geason - 46 - very serious kidney Tr. - Mother of very fine family - 8 sons & 3 daughters - just lost her 12th.
Alex Morrin - 32 - Bay City - tuomer on brain feared.
1942, August
Page 42
Aug. 3 James Walters - 12 - several years peculiar infantile paralysis
4 Josephine Kahrs - 82 - N. Y. - Throat-cancer ....
Albert Bauman - 2 - brain inflamation, no hope Drs say.
4 Thanks - Mrs. Helen Wejrowski - broken back last November. Grace Hospital - Enrolled several times .... still wears brace but nicely able to get around and do her work ... Enrolled To-day as a perpetual - according to promise.
4 Shirley Ann Gheldaf - 6 - deaf & Dumb since birth. Bright and alert though thin. Many times given up as hopeless.
Thanks - Robert Harrison - 60 - threatened with very serious oper- ation. In fact, Dr's advised to let patient die - nothing could be done .... Enrolled as a perpetual member July 20th. Next day quite improved. Here To-day feeling ... looking fine. Deo.
Anna Bergeron - 52 - extremely nervous - mentally very weak - dis- pairs of God's mercy ....
Page 43 Aug. 4 Robert Weier - 12 - plurisy for several weeks - had pneumonia and poorly since with
June 1st Wm. Campbell - 20 - injured at birth and has something like spasicic paralysis - Drs. give very little hope ...
Brother James - 77 - of Seattle
